title: Simple design, well made.
text:
Simple design, well made.. Love this bed. Love the simple design. I would prefer it in vinyl but I received a fabric design which is very nice. The frame is sturdy and heavy. You'll need help putting it together because it is heavy. The gray color is a nice versatile color. It goes with a wide variety of wall/room colors. Gray is currently an "in" color.

Overall, it is well designed and well made. Recommended.
